title: Explicit data form of the geometric product Picard openness construction
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-sc-picard-product-open, there exist an open neighbourhood U of s, an auxiliary module N, an explicit isomorphism from L restricted to U to N, and an explicit isomorphism from N to the unit module.

proof.text: Carry out the Picard-locus construction, retaining the two resulting isomorphisms as explicit witnesses rather than packaging them in Nonempty.

lean.statement: theorem picard_product_open_data {S X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (g : Y ⟶ S) [Flat f] [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] [Flat g] [IsProper g] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation g] (σ : S ⟶ X) (τ : S ⟶ Y) (hσ : σ ≫ f = 𝟙 S) (hτ : τ ≫ g = 𝟙 S) (s : S) (L : (pullback f g).Modules) [L.IsInvertible] (hO : ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (t : T ⟶ S), IsIso ((Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd f t))).unit.app (SheafOfModules.unit T.ringCatSheaf))) (hO' : ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (t : T ⟶ S), IsIso ((Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd g t))).unit.app (SheafOfModules.unit T.ringCatSheaf))) (h₁ : Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.lift (𝟙 X) (f ≫ τ) (by simp [hτ]))).obj L ≅ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)) (h₂ : Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.lift (g ≫ σ) (𝟙 Y) (by simp [hσ]))).obj L ≅ SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf)) (hs : Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback ((pullback.fst f g ≫ f).fiberι s)).obj L ≅ SheafOfModules.unit _)) : ∃ U : S.Opens, s ∈ U ∧ ∃ N : (pullback (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) U.ι).Modules, ∃ eL : (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) U.ι)).obj L ≅ N, ∃ eN : N ≅ SheafOfModules.unit (pullback (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) U.ι).ringCatSheaf, True
